article.title: Common IELTS Writing mistakes that cost band score
article.description: Top mistakes: (1) Not answering the exact question asked, (2) Memorized 'template' phrases that sound unnatural, (3) Word count too low (under 250 for Task 2), (4) Overusing complex vocabulary incorrectly instead of using simpler, accurate words, (5) No clear paragraph structure. Tip: accuracy matters more than 'impressive' vocabulary used wrong.
article.content: Top mistakes: (1) Not answering the exact question asked, (2) Memorized 'template' phrases that sound unnatural, (3) Word count too low (under 250 for Task 2), (4) Overusing complex vocabulary incorrectly instead of using simpler, accurate words, (5) No clear paragraph structure. Tip: accuracy matters more than 'impressive' vocabulary used wrong.

generated.caption:
Worried your IELTS Writing isn't hitting the band score you want?

It's often about accuracy over complexity! Using simpler, correct words is far better than misusing complex ones. For example, "The chart *shows*" is perfectly clear. Always answer the *exact* question, hit the word count, and use clear paragraph structures. Ditch unnatural memorized phrases!

generated.script: IELTS Writing mein high score chahiye, par ye galti karte ho? Dekho, bohot log sochte hain ki bas lambe-lambe sentences aur tough words use karne se band score badhega. Par aisa nahi hai. Sabse common mistakes hain: Not answering the exact question asked – aap question theek se samajhte hi nahi! Phir aata hai using memorized 'template' phrases, jo completely unnatural lagte hain. Word count bhi kam ho jata hai – Task 2 mein 250 se neeche mat jaana! Aur most critical, overusing complex vocabulary incorrectly. Yaad rakho, accuracy matters more than 'impressive' vocabulary used wrong. Simple aur accurate words use karo, over-the-top nahi. Clear paragraph structure is also crucial, uske bina writing weak lagti hai. Toh ab samajh aaya? IELTS Writing mein accuracy aur clarity sabse important hai. Simple aur sahi likho, templates aur mushkil shabdon ke peeche mat bhaago. Comment karke batao aapko ye mistakes pata the ya nahi! Aur aise hi tips ke liye The English Vault ko follow karo!

slides.body: When it comes to IELTS writing, there are several common mistakes that can cost you valuable band scores. Not answering the exact question asked is a major error, as is relying on memorized 'template' phrases that sound unnatural. Additionally, ensuring your word count meets the requirements, such as exceeding 250 words for Task 2, and using accurate vocabulary are crucial. It's also important to have a clear paragraph structure, rather than overusing complex vocabulary incorrectly. Remember, accuracy matters more than using 'impressive' vocabulary the wrong way.
